description:
A hyena-headed Gnoll raider with spotted tan fur, a hunched alert stance, strong bite, ragged red-brown clothing, and 12 ep plus 8 gp in the source wealth record. The original monster template carried no items; the saved catalog now adds a readied one-handed Morning star and Shield. Preserve the existing default art and create a separate ready/action pair for this gear set.

IMAGEGEN PROMPT - READY:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: READY frame for MON8CHA.DAX:73/added_55495049383__added_55503699453, one transparent 128x128 combat PNG.
Input Image 1: the existing checked-in MON8CHA.DAX:73/default/ready.png is the EDIT TARGET. Its ORIGINAL Gnoll body, head, expression, proportions, spots, mane, ragged red clothing, tail, limbs and every planted foot pixel must remain the visible base. Input Image 2: the approved bipedal pose guide is ONLY a camera and raised-weapon reference; it must not supply another body, costume, sword or shield design. No original game artwork is supplied.
Make ONLY a localized equipment addition to Image 1. Equip the Gnoll's image-LEFT hand with a one-handed MORNING STAR, a rigid short straight haft with a small clearly spiked iron ball permanently fixed at the tip, held UP diagonally beside the head ready to strike. No chain, no flail. Equip the image-RIGHT forearm with one sturdy round shield, held in guard in front of that side. Keep the original face and chest visible. Reposition just the hands/forearms enough for plausible grips and shield strap; do not redraw or enlarge the character.
Pixel identity requirements: Keep the original head, torso, abdomen, loincloth, tail, pelvis, legs, feet and spotted fur pattern exactly the same visual artwork, at the same coordinates and scale. Preserve the existing hunched front-three-quarter rightward stance and the same overall apparent body height. Do not make the Gnoll more muscular, upright, heavily clothed or different in color. Do not invent necklaces, belt ropes, new armor, jewelry, or other gear. Keep neck through hips continuously connected. Shield and body stay in the saved 1-wide by 2-high footprint; the raised morning star may reach upward but all pixels remain within the 128x128 transparent canvas with margin.
ONE ready sprite only. Crisp existing pixel-art style, true alpha. No scene, painted background, halo, black box, label, border or copied game art.

IMAGEGEN PROMPT - ACTION:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: ACTION frame for MON8CHA.DAX:73/added_55495049383__added_55503699453, one transparent 128x128 combat PNG.
Input Image 1: the accepted new Morning star + Shield ready sprite is the EDIT TARGET and exact identity, handedness, scale, shield and foot-position reference. Input Image 2: the checked-in default/action.png is a motion reference for the SAME original Gnoll, without its unarmed hands. Input Image 3: the approved bipedal pose guide indicates screen-right late strike direction only, not character design.
Keep the original spotted tan Gnoll body, large hyena head, mane, red ragged clothing, tail, pelvis, legs and planted feet at the SAME pixels as ready. Animate only the image-LEFT weapon forearm and modest shoulder/upper-body follow-through. Swing the rigid morning star down and forward toward screen right to a late strike, with the SAME hand gripping the short shaft and the SAME recognizable spiked head still attached; no chain or flail. Keep the round shield strapped to the image-RIGHT forearm in both frames. The shield arm may brace but does not become the attacking arm. Keep neck, chest, abdomen and hips connected with no seam, shift, duplicate edge or detached half. Do not shrink or recenter the body to fit the weapon. The body/shield remain within the 1-wide by 2-high tile footprint; the attacking morning star may cross its border but stays inside the PNG with margin.
ONE action sprite only, matching ready's pixel-art colors and perspective with true transparency. No extra equipment, new ornaments, magical effects, backdrop, ground shadow, text, black box or cropped feet.
